description: This file is a Shell script containing a suite of test cases for Git's cruft pack repacking functionality. It includes various setup procedures, function definitions, and multiple tests verifying behaviors such as object expiry, pack size limits, cruft pack inclusion/exclusion, pack rewriting, and index management related to Git's pack-repacking mechanics.

methods.name: find_pack
methods.description: Searches for pack index files containing a specific object hash, returning matching index filenames.

methods.name: setup_cruft_exclude_tests
methods.description: Initializes a Git repository with specific commits and merges to set up test conditions for cruft pack exclusion.

methods.name: generate_random_blob
methods.description: Creates a random blob object of specified size, adds it to the index, and then removes the temporary file.

methods.name: pack_random_blob
methods.description: Generates a random blob and repacks it into the repository.

methods.name: generate_cruft_pack
methods.description: Creates a cruft pack by packing a random blob, then returns the path to its mtimes file for testing.
